bard.name: Blade Ward
bard.description: While you concentrate, every attack roll made against you is reduced by 1d4, blunting incoming blows before they land.

bard.name: Dancing Lights
bard.description: Up to four drifting lights — torches, lanterns, or a vaguely humanoid shape — float where you direct them, shedding dim light. You can move and recombine them as a bonus action while you concentrate.

bard.name: Friends
bard.description: You magically influence one creature you can see, which makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for the duration. When the spell ends, the target knows it was charmed.

bard.name: Light
bard.description: An object you touch glows like a torch, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light beyond it. A hostile creature wearing or holding the object can resist with a Dexterity save.

bard.name: Mage Hand
bard.description: A spectral floating hand appears and obeys your gestures for a minute: it can manipulate objects, open unlocked containers, retrieve items, and pour potions, but it cannot attack or carry more than 10 pounds.

bard.name: Mending
bard.description: Your touch knits a single break or tear in an object back together — a snapped chain link, a torn cloak, a cracked key — so long as the damage is no more than a foot in any dimension.

bard.name: Message
bard.description: You point at a creature and whisper a message only it can hear; it can whisper a reply that only you hear. The whisper can pass around corners and through thin barriers, but not through stone, metal, or lead of any real thickness.

bard.name: Minor Illusion
bard.description: You craft a false sound or a still image no larger than a 5-foot cube — a voice, a crash, a chest, a set of footprints. Creatures can see through it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check, and physical interaction reveals it.

bard.name: Prestidigitation
bard.description: The classic bag of minor wonders: light or snuff a candle, clean or soil an object, chill or flavor food, conjure a harmless sensory effect or a tiny trinket. Up to three such effects can run at once.

bard.name: Thunderclap
bard.description: You loose a crack of thunder audible 100 feet away. Every other creature within 5 feet of you makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 thunder damage, scaling at higher levels.

bard.name: True Strike
bard.description: As part of casting, you make one attack with a weapon, using your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls. The damage can be radiant instead of the weapon's normal type, and extra radiant damage is added at higher levels, up to +3d6 at 17th.

bard.name: Vicious Mockery
bard.description: A string of magically laced insults: the target makes a Wisdom save or takes psychic damage (1d6) and has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

cleric.name: Guidance
cleric.description: You touch a willing creature and choose one skill. For the duration (up to 1 minute, concentration), whenever the creature makes an ability check with that skill, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the check.

cleric.name: Light
cleric.description: An object you touch glows like a torch, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light beyond it. A hostile creature wearing or holding the object can resist with a Dexterity save.

cleric.name: Mending
cleric.description: Your touch knits a single break or tear in an object back together — a snapped chain link, a torn cloak, a cracked key — so long as the damage is no more than a foot in any dimension.

cleric.name: Resistance
cleric.description: You touch one willing creature and choose a damage type: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, piercing, poison, radiant, slashing, or thunder. While you concentrate (up to 1 minute), when the creature takes damage of that type, it reduces the damage by 1d4. The creature can benefit from this only once per turn.

cleric.name: Sacred Flame
cleric.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see, which makes a Dexterity save — gaining no benefit from cover — or takes 1d8 radiant damage. The damage increases at higher levels.

cleric.name: Spare the Dying
cleric.description: You stabilize a dying creature at range — 15 feet, growing to 30, 60, and finally 120 feet as you reach higher levels — so it no longer needs death saving throws.

cleric.name: Thaumaturgy
cleric.description: Minor divine wonders announce your power: your voice booms, the ground trembles, flames flicker, doors fly open or slam shut, or your eyes change appearance. Up to three effects can run at once.

cleric.name: Toll the Dead
cleric.description: A dolorous bell tolls for one creature, which makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d8 necrotic damage — or 1d12 if it is already missing hit points. The damage scales at higher levels.

cleric.name: Word of Radiance
cleric.description: Burning radiance flashes out from you in every direction. Each creature of your choice within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage, scaling at higher levels.

druid.name: Druidcraft
druid.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you predict the weather for the next day, make a flower bloom or a seed pod open, create a harmless nature effect, or light or snuff a small flame.

druid.name: Guidance
druid.description: You touch a willing creature and choose one skill. For the duration (up to 1 minute, concentration), whenever the creature makes an ability check with that skill, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the check.

druid.name: Mending
druid.description: Your touch knits a single break or tear in an object back together — a snapped chain link, a torn cloak, a cracked key — so long as the damage is no more than a foot in any dimension.

druid.name: Poison Spray
druid.description: With a 30-foot range, you project a puff of noxious gas with a ranged spell attack. On a hit the target takes 1d12 poison damage, scaling at higher levels.

druid.name: Produce Flame
druid.description: A flame blooms in your hand, shedding light like a torch. You conjure it with a bonus action and can hurl it with an action as a ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 fire damage; the damage grows at higher levels.

druid.name: Resistance
druid.description: You touch one willing creature and choose a damage type: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, piercing, poison, radiant, slashing, or thunder. While you concentrate (up to 1 minute), when the creature takes damage of that type, it reduces the damage by 1d4. The creature can benefit from this only once per turn.

druid.name: Shillelagh
druid.description: The club or quarterstaff in your hand is imbued with nature's power: you can use your spellcasting ability for its attacks, and its damage becomes force damage with a die that grows as you level.

druid.name: Thorn Whip
druid.description: A whip of thorny vines lashes out in a melee spell attack despite its 30-foot reach, dealing 1d6 piercing damage on a hit and dragging the target up to 10 feet toward you if it is no more than one size larger.

sorcerer.name: Acid Splash
sorcerer.description: A stinging bubble of acid bursts over one creature, or two creatures standing within 5 feet of each other. Each target makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 acid damage, and the damage grows as you reach higher levels.

sorcerer.name: Blade Ward
sorcerer.description: While you concentrate, every attack roll made against you is reduced by 1d4, blunting incoming blows before they land.

sorcerer.name: Chill Touch
sorcerer.description: A skeletal hand of grave-cold energy closes on a creature you touch with a melee spell attack, dealing 1d10 necrotic damage. The chill lingers: the target cannot regain hit points until the end of your next turn, and undead also have disadvantage on attacks against you.

sorcerer.name: Dancing Lights
sorcerer.description: Up to four drifting lights — torches, lanterns, or a vaguely humanoid shape — float where you direct them, shedding dim light. You can move and recombine them as a bonus action while you concentrate.

sorcerer.name: Fire Bolt
sorcerer.description: You hurl a mote of fire with a ranged spell attack, dealing 1d10 fire damage on a hit and igniting flammable objects that are not worn or carried. The damage increases at higher levels.

sorcerer.name: Friends
sorcerer.description: You magically influence one creature you can see, which makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for the duration. When the spell ends, the target knows it was charmed.

sorcerer.description: The classic bag of minor wonders: light or snuff a candle, clean or soil an object, chill or flavor food, conjure a harmless sensory effect or a tiny trinket. Up to three such effects can run at once.

sorcerer.name: Ray of Frost
sorcerer.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light strikes on a ranged spell attack for 1d8 cold damage, and the chill slows the target, reducing its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

sorcerer.name: Shocking Grasp
sorcerer.description: Lightning springs from your hand in a melee spell attack for 1d8 lightning damage, with advantage if the target wears metal armor. A hit also robs the target of its reaction until its next turn.

sorcerer.name: True Strike
sorcerer.description: As part of casting, you make one attack with a weapon, using your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls. The damage can be radiant instead of the weapon's normal type, and extra radiant damage is added at higher levels, up to +3d6 at 17th.

warlock.name: Eldritch Blast
warlock.description: A crackling beam of eldritch force streaks at a creature; on a hit with your ranged spell attack it takes 1d10 force damage. You loose additional beams at higher levels (two at 5th, three at 11th, four at 17th), each rolled separately.

artificer.name: Create Bonfire
artificer.description: A bonfire fills a 5-foot cube on the ground. Any creature in its space when it appears, that enters it, or that ends its turn there makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 fire damage, scaling at higher levels.

artificer.name: Magic Stone
artificer.description: You imbue up to three pebbles with magic for a minute. You or an ally can hurl one with a ranged spell attack (60 feet) dealing 1d6 plus your spellcasting modifier in bludgeoning damage.

1st.name: Alarm
1st.description: You ward a door, window, or 20-foot cube for 8 hours. When a creature you have not designated enters the area, the spell alerts you with a mental ping if you are awake, or a ringing bell if you are asleep.

1st.name: Animal Friendship
1st.description: A beast with low Intelligence makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 24 hours. If you or your allies harm it, the spell ends; upcasting lets you befriend one additional beast per level.

1st.name: Armor of Agathys
1st.description: Spectral frost armors you: you gain 5 temporary hit points, and while any of them remain, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage. Both amounts rise by 5 per slot level above 1st.

1st.name: Arms of Hadar
1st.description: Shadowy tendrils erupt from you in every direction. Each other creature within 10 feet makes a Strength save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage and losing its reaction on a failure, or half damage on a success.

1st.name: Bane
1st.description: Up to three creatures make Charisma saves; each that fails subtracts 1d4 from its attack rolls and saving throws for the duration. Upcasting adds one more target per level.

1st.name: Bless
1st.description: You bless up to three creatures. Whenever a blessed creature makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, it adds 1d4 to the roll. Upcasting adds one more target per level.

1st.name: Burning Hands
1st.description: A sheet of flame roars from your outstretched fingers. Each creature in the 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success, and unattended flammables ignite.

1st.name: Charm Person
1st.description: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save (with advantage if you are fighting it) or is charmed for an hour, regarding you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends it knows it was charmed; upcasting targets one more humanoid per level.

1st.name: Color Spray
1st.description: A dazzling array of flashing color sprays from your hand. Every creature in the 15-foot cone simply makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the end of its next turn.

1st.name: Command
1st.description: You speak a one-word command — Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt — to a creature that makes a Wisdom save or obeys on its next turn. Upcasting commands one additional creature per level.

1st.name: Comprehend Languages
1st.description: For an hour you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear and can read any written language you touch, though decoding secret writing and ciphers is beyond it.

1st.name: Create or Destroy Water
1st.description: You create up to 10 gallons of clean water (as rain in a 30-foot cube, or in an open container) or destroy up to 10 gallons, and can also disperse fog in the area. The volume doubles with each higher slot.

1st.name: Cure Wounds
1st.description: Your touch closes wounds: a creature regains 2d8 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier, and 2d8 more for each slot level above 1st.

1st.name: Detect Evil and Good
1st.description: While you concentrate you sense whether any aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead is within 30 feet, and whether any object or place nearby has been consecrated or desecrated, though cover can block the sense.

1st.name: Detect Magic
1st.description: You sense the presence of magic within 30 feet; using an action while it lasts, you can see a faint aura around any creature or object bearing magic and learn its school. Thin barriers block it, and it is often cast as a ritual.

1st.name: Detect Poison and Disease
1st.description: You sense the presence and kind of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet while you concentrate, though solid barriers block the sense.

1st.name: Disguise Self
1st.description: You make yourself — clothes, armor, and gear included — look like someone else of roughly your build for an hour. The disguise is visual only: it fails to touch, and a suspicious creature can pierce it with an Intelligence (Investigation) check.

1st.name: Dissonant Whispers
1st.description: A discordant melody only one creature can hear wracks it with pain: Wisdom save or 3d6 psychic damage and it must immediately use its reaction to flee from you; on a success it takes half damage and does not flee.

1st.name: Divine Favor
1st.description: Your weapon strikes are blessed for a minute, dealing an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit. No concentration required.

1st.name: Entangle
1st.description: Grasping weeds and vines fill a 20-foot square, making it difficult terrain. Creatures in the area make Strength saves or are restrained until they break free with a Strength check as an action.

1st.name: Expeditious Retreat
1st.description: Magic lends speed to your heels: when you cast it and as a bonus action on later turns while you concentrate, you can take the Dash action.

1st.name: Faerie Fire
1st.description: Objects and creatures in a 20-foot cube are outlined in colored light. Creatures that fail a Dexterity save shed dim light for the duration, and attacks against outlined creatures have advantage if the attacker can see them.

1st.name: False Life
1st.description: A necromantic facsimile of life bolsters you: you gain 2d4 + 4 temporary hit points, plus 5 more for each slot level above 1st.

1st.name: Feather Fall
1st.description: Cast in reaction when you or a creature within 60 feet falls: up to five falling creatures descend at a gentle 60 feet per round and land on their feet unharmed.

1st.name: Find Familiar
1st.description: You gain the service of a familiar — a celestial, fey, or fiend spirit in the form of a small animal such as a bat, cat, owl, or toad. It acts independently but obeys you, cannot attack, and you can see through its eyes and deliver touch spells through it.

1st.name: Fog Cloud
1st.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of fog billows out, heavily obscuring its area until a strong wind disperses it. Its radius grows by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

1st.name: Goodberry
1st.description: Ten magical berries appear in your hand, fresh for 24 hours. Eating one restores 1 hit point and nourishes the creature for a full day.

1st.name: Grease
1st.description: Slick grease coats a 10-foot square (it is not flammable). Creatures in the area, and any that enter or end their turn there, make Dexterity saves or fall prone.

1st.name: Guiding Bolt
1st.description: A flash of divine light: ranged spell attack for 4d6 radiant damage, and the target shimmers with mystical light so the next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn has advantage. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

1st.name: Healing Word
1st.description: A word of comfort knits wounds at range: one creature regains 2d4 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier — leaving your action free, and gains 2d4 more per higher slot.

1st.name: Hellish Rebuke
1st.description: Cast in reaction to being damaged: you point at the creature that hurt you and it is momentarily engulfed in hellish flame, making a Dexterity save or taking 2d10 fire damage (half on a success). Each higher slot adds 1d10.

1st.name: Heroism
1st.description: A willing creature is flooded with courage: it is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier at the start of each of its turns while you concentrate.

1st.name: Hex
1st.description: You curse a creature: your attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage to it, and it has disadvantage on ability checks with one ability you choose. If it dies, you can move the curse to a new creature; the duration stretches to 8 or 24 hours in higher slots.

1st.name: Hunter's Mark
1st.description: You mark a creature as your quarry: your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage to it, and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it. If it falls, you can move the mark to a new creature with a bonus action.

1st.name: Identify
1st.description: Handling an item or creature throughout the casting, you learn its magical properties, how to use them, whether it requires attunement, and how many charges it holds; on a creature you learn which spells are affecting it.

1st.name: Illusory Script
1st.description: You write a message that appears as entirely different writing to everyone except creatures you designate. Others see whatever innocent text you choose; truesight pierces the deception.

1st.name: Inflict Wounds
1st.description: Your touch channels necrotic energy into a creature, which makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Each higher slot adds 1d10.

1st.name: Jump
1st.description: As a bonus action you touch a creature and, once on each of its turns for a minute, it can jump up to 30 feet by spending only 10 feet of movement.

1st.name: Longstrider
1st.description: You touch a creature and quicken it: its speed increases by 10 feet for an hour. Each higher slot quickens one additional creature.

1st.name: Mage Armor
1st.description: A protective force surrounds a willing creature that is not wearing armor: its base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier for 8 hours, ending early if it dons armor.

1st.name: Magic Missile
1st.description: Three glowing darts of force strike creatures of your choice, unerringly, each dealing 1d4 + 1 force damage (3d4 + 3 total if all strike one target). Each higher slot creates one additional dart.

1st.name: Protection from Evil and Good
1st.description: One willing creature is warded against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead: such creatures attack it at disadvantage, and it cannot be charmed, frightened, or possessed by them.

1st.name: Purify Food and Drink
1st.description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere is purified, rendered free of poison and disease — a ritual that makes suspect rations safe.

1st.name: Sanctuary
1st.description: You ward a creature for a minute: any attacker must make a Wisdom save or choose a new target (or lose the attack). The ward ends for a creature that attacks, casts a harmful spell, or deals damage.

1st.name: Searing Smite
1st.description: Cast as you hit with a weapon: the strike deals an extra 1d6 fire damage and ignites the target, which takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it makes a Constitution save (or is doused) to end the flames. Both rolls rise 1d6 per higher slot.

1st.name: Shield
1st.description: Cast in reaction to being hit or targeted by Magic Missile: an invisible barrier gives you +5 AC until the start of your next turn — including against the triggering attack — and Magic Missile deals you no damage.

1st.name: Shield of Faith
1st.description: A shimmering field protects one creature you choose, granting it a +2 bonus to AC while you concentrate, for up to 10 minutes.

1st.name: Silent Image
1st.description: You create the image of an object, creature, or phenomenon no larger than a 15-foot cube, and can move it with your action while it stays in range. It has no sound, smell, or substance; interaction or an Investigation check reveals it.

1st.name: Sleep
1st.description: Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere makes a Wisdom save or is incapacitated, and repeats the save at the end of its next turn, falling unconscious for the duration on a second failure. Damage or a slap wakes a sleeper early.

1st.name: Speak with Animals
1st.description: For 10 minutes you can comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts, learning what they have seen and enlisting simple favors — what they tell you is limited by their intelligence and senses.

1st.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
1st.description: A creature perceives everything as hilariously funny and collapses: Wisdom save or it falls prone and is incapacitated by laughter, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage (with advantage).

1st.name: Tenser's Floating Disk
1st.description: A circular plane of force, 3 feet across, hovers just off the ground and follows you at a distance, carrying up to 500 pounds of cargo like the most loyal of porters. It cannot cross drops deeper than 10 feet.

1st.name: Thunderous Smite
1st.description: Cast as you hit with a melee weapon: the strike rings like a thunderclap, dealing an extra 2d6 thunder damage, and the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

1st.name: Thunderwave
1st.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you, audible 300 feet away. Each other creature in a 15-foot cube makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet on a failure, or half damage on a success.

1st.name: Unseen Servant
1st.description: An invisible, mindless force performs simple tasks at your command for an hour — fetching, cleaning, serving, opening unstuck doors — with the strength of a frail servant, ending if it takes any real punishment.

1st.name: Witch Bolt
1st.description: A beam of crackling energy tethers you to a target on a ranged spell attack hit for 2d12 lightning damage, and you can use a bonus action on later turns to deal 1d12 lightning damage automatically. Each higher slot adds 1d12 to the initial damage.

1st.name: Wrathful Smite
1st.description: Cast as you hit, the strike deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage and the target makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you until it gathers its nerve with a Wisdom check as an action. Each higher slot adds 1d6.

2nd.name: Aid
2nd.description: Your blessing bolsters up to three creatures: each one's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for 8 hours. Each higher slot raises the bonus by 5.

2nd.name: Blindness/Deafness
2nd.description: You rob one creature of a sense: Constitution save or it is blinded or deafened (your choice) for a minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Each higher slot afflicts one more creature.

2nd.name: Branding Smite
2nd.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack during the spell, the attack deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage, and the target sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and cannot benefit from invisibility until the spell ends. Higher slots add 1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

2nd.name: Calm Emotions
2nd.description: You settle a crowd's spirit: each humanoid in a 20-foot sphere makes a Charisma save or has any charm or fright effect on it suppressed, or is made indifferent to creatures it was hostile toward (unless attacked).

2nd.name: Darkness
2nd.description: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot sphere that even darkvision cannot pierce and nonmagical light cannot brighten. Cast it on a small object and carry the darkness with you, covering the object to shut it off.

2nd.name: Enhance Ability
2nd.description: You touch a creature and choose an ability score; for up to an hour it has advantage on ability checks using that score. Each higher slot touches one more creature.

2nd.name: Hold Person
2nd.description: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Attacks against a paralyzed creature have advantage, and hits from within 5 feet are automatic criticals. Each higher slot targets one more humanoid.

2nd.name: Invisibility
2nd.description: A creature you touch vanishes from sight until it attacks, casts a spell, or your concentration ends. Each higher slot hides one additional creature.

2nd.name: Lesser Restoration
2nd.description: As a bonus action, your touch ends one condition afflicting a creature — blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

2nd.name: Locate Object
2nd.description: You sense the direction to an object you name — a specific one you have seen up close, or a kind of object — so long as it is within 1,000 feet. A thin sheet of lead blocks the sense entirely.

2nd.name: Misty Step
2nd.description: Briefly veiled in silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see — the classic bonus-action escape.

2nd.name: Moonbeam
2nd.description: A silvery beam of moonlight, 5 feet wide and 40 feet tall, shines down where you point. A creature that enters the beam or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 radiant damage on a failure (half on a success), and shapechangers save at disadvantage and revert. You can move the beam 60 feet as a Magic action.

2nd.name: Prayer of Healing
2nd.description: A 10-minute prayer restores up to five creatures: each regains 2d8 hit points (no modifier added) and also gains the benefit of a short rest. Each higher slot adds 1d8 healing.

2nd.name: Scorching Ray
2nd.description: Three rays of fire streak at targets of your choice, each a separate ranged spell attack dealing 2d6 fire damage on a hit. Each higher slot creates one additional ray.

2nd.name: Shatter
2nd.description: A sudden ringing noise like a struck bell erupts in a 10-foot sphere: Constitution save or 3d8 thunder damage (half on a success). Creatures of crystal, stone, or metal save at disadvantage, and loose objects take the damage too. Each higher slot adds 1d8.

2nd.name: Silence
2nd.description: A 20-foot sphere of absolute silence: no sound can be created in or pass through it, creatures fully inside are immune to thunder damage, and verbal spellcasting is impossible there. Often cast as a ritual against enemy casters.

2nd.name: Spiritual Weapon
2nd.description: A floating weapon of force — often your deity's favored arm — appears and strikes on a melee spell attack for 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier force damage; as a bonus action you can move it 20 feet and strike again. Requires concentration. Higher slots raise the damage every two levels.

2nd.name: Suggestion
2nd.description: You suggest a course of activity of up to 25 words, phrased to sound reasonable: Wisdom save or the charmed creature pursues it to the best of its ability. The spell ends if you or allies damage the target.

2nd.name: Warding Bond
2nd.description: You and a willing creature, each wearing one of a pair of platinum rings, are mystically linked: it gains +1 AC and saving throws and resistance to all damage — and every point of damage it takes, you take too.

2nd.name: Web
2nd.description: Thick, sticky webbing fills a 20-foot cube, lightly obscuring it and making difficult terrain. Creatures starting there or entering make Dexterity saves or are restrained until they break free with a Strength check; the webs are flammable — burning webbing deals 2d4 fire damage to a creature that starts its turn in the fire.
